name: HumanLayer
description: Gates autonomous agent tool calls behind human approval in Slack or email, so high-risk actions require a person to sign off before they execute.

skills.name: Require Approval
skills.description: Wraps a tool call so it blocks until a designated human approves or rejects the action.

skills.name: Contact Human
skills.description: Escalates a question from an agent to a person over Slack, email, or SMS and returns the reply.

skills.name: Approval Audit
skills.description: Records who approved which agent action and when, producing an auditable decision trail.
